related.title: OpenTelemetry：平行span與關鍵路徑
related.titleEn: OpenTelemetry: parallel spans and the critical path
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 counter-intervals.csv、重設對照及PromQL/手算邊界說明。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver counter-intervals.csv,reset comparisons and PromQL-versus-manual boundaries.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 排序區間端點求聯集[10,140]，子活動聯集130 ms；父區間剩20 ms。這不直接等於CPU時間或全分散式關鍵路徑。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Sweep interval endpoints to obtain union[10,140],130 ms,leaving20 ms of the parent outside children; neither quantity directly measures CPU time or an entire distributed critical path. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 (20-90)/30 = -2.3333333333333335 events/s；對照 (100-90+6+20-6)/30 = 1 events/s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐區間增量為10、6、14，共30事件；手算觀察窗平均為1/s。另記重設時刻未知，所以這是明示假設下估計。

基準 (110-10)+(140-60) = 180 ms；對照 100+80-50 = 130 ms。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
排序區間端點求聯集[10,140]，子活動聯集130 ms；父區間剩20 ms。這不直接等於CPU時間或全分散式關鍵路徑。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline (20-90)/30 = -2.3333333333333335 events/s; comparison (100-90+6+20-6)/30 = 1 events/s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Interval increments are10,6,14,total30,so the observed-window mean is1/s; the unknown reset time makes this an assumption-dependent estimate.

Baseline (110-10)+(140-60) = 180 ms; comparison 100+80-50 = 130 ms. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Sweep interval endpoints to obtain union[10,140],130 ms,leaving20 ms of the parent outside children; neither quantity directly measures CPU time or an entire distributed critical path.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
